newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH Q4 OLD APARTMENT PRICES UP 4.5 PCT Q/Q.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH Q4 OLD APARTMENT PRICES UP 4.5 PCT Q/Q.

text.p: Prices of old apartments continued to rise in the final quarter of 1996, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Monday.
On average, the nation-wide rise in the price per square metre was 4.5 percent compared to the previous quarter. In the Helsinki metropolitan area, prices rose 7.6 percent, SF said.
The number of registered deals in old apartments fell around 10 percent in Q4 compared with Q3 to 3,741.

In Q4, the nation-wide average price per square metre was 5,849 markka, up from 5,598 markka in Q3. In the Helsinki metropolitan area, prices rose to on average 8,060 markka per square metre from 7,495 markka.
In the most expensive areas of central Helsinki, prices rose to 10,742 markka per square metre from 9,998 markka.
